title: ExtractEvent
description: One event of an Extract stream.

oneOf.description: The run started.

contract_version.description: The version of the contract it speaks, [`CONTRACT_VERSION`](crate::CONTRACT_VERSION).

oneOf.description:
A document's model output, sent before the document is committed. Store `json` and
send its path back in [`ExtractDocument::artifacts`] to replay it.

key.description:
What the output depends on, hashed: the text, the document's scope, the prompt, the
models and the section size. It names the artifact; a run replays every call any
artifact passed in holds, whatever its key.

oneOf.description: A document of the request's `remove` was taken out of the load.

entities_removed.description:
Entities deleted, left with no row creating them, no document naming them and no
fact.

facts_removed.description: Facts deleted, left with no evidence.

oneOf.description: A document reached its final state.

counts.description: What it put in the graph.

names.description:
What the run did with each name decision of the document: each resolve decision of
it, and each `alias` that met one of its names the resolution ladder asked about.
`written`: what it settles is written, by the document's commit in this run or, of a
document the load held, now, as a load built again with it holds it ("not in data"
takes the name's reviews away); `not_asked`: of a document the load held, its reviews
ask about no such name, and nothing is written; `not_named`: the document names no
entity so; or refused and why. Of a document the load held, `counts` counts what the
run wrote of it. A duplicate or out-of-scope document, or one that fails before its
commit, resolves no name and lists none; one a stopped run ends failed and retryable
after its commit or settling wrote lists what that wrote.

releases.description:
What the run did with each release decision of the request that names the document,
by its `decision_id`: written, refused and why, `missed` (the run committed the
document, and its commit held no review at that key and place) or `not_held` (the
load held the document already, with no such review: one a release wrote before, or
a claim this load never held there). Each withdrawal comes first: `withdrawn`,
`not_written` (the load holds nothing its approval wrote) or refused and why.
`counts` counts reviews, of which one decision may name several, and no withdrawal.

oneOf.description:
What came of moving the load in place ([`ExtractRequest::fold`]), before anything
else of the run.
The run ended; the result follows.

DocumentCounts.description: What one document put in the graph, or would have.

attribute_reviews.description: Property values the verifier was unsure of, written as reviews.

attributes.description: Property values it stated that were written as evidence.

attributes_over_entries.description: Accepted property values left out because its write had no room for them.

created.description: Entities it created, as its routes let it.

entities.description: Entities it names that resolved to the graph's.

identifiers_unverified.description:
Identifiers it gave entities that the verifier didn't accept, or that its text doesn't
write: none resolved an entity.

prop_conflicts.description:
Properties whose evidence now disagrees, with each other or with a row's value: each a
review.

rejected.description: Facts the verifier rejected, kept only in the artifact.

release_missed.description:
Release decisions of a document this run committed that name no review of it: its claim
has another key or place now, or the commit held no such claim.

release_refused.description:
Reviews a person released that stay held: an end no rung resolves, statements that differ
at one place, a statement other than the one approved, a value another statement disputes,
a `block` constraint it would break, or a review a release can't write.

released.description: Reviews a person released that were written as facts.

resolved.description: How its entities resolved, by rung.

unresolved.description: Names that resolved to no entity, or to several.

oneOf.description: It was committed.
No route reads its set: it was stored with its sections, and no model was asked.
The load already held it, by id and content.
The load holds the same text under another id.
It couldn't be extracted or committed.

retryable.description: Whether a later run may succeed.

oneOf.description: Its text, or its commit, is past a limit.
Its format isn't read.
A model call failed.
The store refused its commit.

replayed.description: Whether every model call it needed replayed from an artifact, at no cost.

usd_micros.description: The cost, in millionths of a US dollar.

Folded.description: What came of moving a load in place ([`ExtractEvent::Fold`]).

oneOf.description:
The load records the request's version now, gaining these links, which none of its
documents was asked: by this run, or by an earlier one.

links_added.description: The links added, or newly routed, by name.

oneOf.description: The change adds more than that: nothing was written.

why.description: What needs a new load, in file then table order.

oneOf.description: The load records neither version, but this one: nothing was written.

ModelFailure.description: Why a model call failed for good, as the contract's model failures name it.

oneOf.description: The model declined the request.
The provider was unavailable, overloaded or broke off, retries included.
The provider refused the API key.
The key may not use the model.
The provider has no such model.
The provider kept limiting the rate of calls, retries included.
The account is out of credit or quota.
The request is too long for the model.

The model or endpoint can't do what the request asks (tool calls, structured answers),
or refused it as invalid.
The answer hit the output limit.

The answer couldn't be read: not the JSON asked for, or a stream that broke its
protocol.
The call ran out of time.
The model's weights changed since it was tested.
The endpoint resolves to a private address.

NameDecision.description: Which kind of name decision a [`NamedDecision`] is.

oneOf.description: A resolve decision of the document.
A name the load carries to every document.

NameOutcome.description: What became of a name decision of a document.

oneOf.description:
What it settles is written: by the document's commit in this run, or, of a document the
load held, now, as a load built again with it holds it. "Not in data" takes the name's
reviews away.

Of a document the load held: its reviews ask about no such name, so nothing waited on
the decision and nothing is written, as a decision sent again once written finds. What
the document's commit linked the name to stays, so a choice other than the one it
applied takes effect when the document is committed again: on a new load, or sent
again with a removal of it.
The document names no entity so: nothing to settle.

The name isn't settled. Of a document the load held, where the decision still changes
how a name its reviews ask about is asked (as a carried name that yields, or two
decisions that choose one entity), the name's review is written again as a load built
with the decision writes it; else nothing is.

NameRefusal.description: Why a name decision didn't settle its name.

oneOf.description: The entity it chose isn't in the load, or its type's identity no longer reads it.

Of a document the load held: the load links the name already, by a rung a person can
overturn or by another choice. Changing that link takes the document sent again with a
removal of it, in one request.

Another of the document's entities is the chosen entity, or would be linked otherwise
with it. A carried name yields, so the document's own link stands, and the name is
asked again offering the chosen entity; a resolve decision leaves both names a
collision for a person. Of a document the load held, a decision that would change
another of its names writes nothing: send it again with a removal of it.

Of a document the load held: what the load holds of its names isn't what its commit
gives, run again, as after a commit by another version, a choice of a name it doesn't
ask about changed since, or a row that a name now reaches arrived since. Send it again
with a removal.
Said of every decision of a name its reviews ask about: none is written.

The write was past what the store takes in one, or the document holds more reviews than
one read takes. Of a document the load held, said of every decision of a name its
reviews ask about: none is written.

Of a carried name: the names rung finds another entity for the name too, or two aliases
of the name choose different entities.

Of a carried name: a role or defined term ("Customer", "the Company"), which says what a
party does in one document, not who it is.
Of a carried name: another of the document's entities goes by it too.

Of a carried name: a verified identifier the document gives the entity found no row, so
it is none of them.

Of a carried name: the entity's names state a legal form that a name of the chosen
entity shows to be another legal person's.

Of a document the load held: its model work couldn't be replayed, as its saved work lacks
a call settling the name asks (as the values in other words, asked since 4.13.0, of a load
committed before) and the run has no budget for it, or a call the run asked failed. It is
settled when the document is committed again, or sent again with a budget.

NamedDecision.description:
What a run did with one name decision of a document's: a resolve decision of the document
([`Decision::Resolve`]), or a name the load carries ([`Decision::Alias`]) that met the
fullest name of one of its entities where the names rung would otherwise have asked. A
carried name the rung links by itself isn't listed: the ladder didn't ask.

decision.description: Which kind of decision it is.

decision_id.description: The decision's `decision_id`, if the request named it.

outcome.description: What the run did with it.

PhaseUsage.description: What one phase's model calls spent.

calls.description: Calls asked of a model, replays left out.

usd_micros.description: The cost, in millionths of a US dollar.

PhaseUsages.description: What a document's model calls spent, by phase of extraction.

adjudicate.description: Candidate assessment and independent identity pairing.

link.description: The link and attribute pass, gleanings included.

ReleaseOutcome.description: What became of a release decision.

oneOf.description: Every review it names was written as what it states.
Its reviews stay held; of a withdrawal, what its approval wrote stays.

The run committed the document, and the commit held no review at its key and place: the
claim has another key or place now.

The load held the document already, with no review at its key and place: one a release
wrote before, as a decision sent again finds, or a claim this load never held there.

Of a withdrawal: what the approval wrote no longer acts. Its claim is held again, with
its review, or, where nothing holds it back any more (it was held for a conflict that is
gone), stays written as its document's own statement, with no approval to rank it.

Of a withdrawal: the load holds nothing the approval wrote. It was never written, was
taken back already, as a withdrawal sent again finds, or another decision wrote the claim
since.

ReleaseRefusal.description: Why a release decision's reviews stay held.

oneOf.description:
The document holds more reviews under the keys its decisions name than one read takes,
or the write, a release's or a withdrawal's, was past what the store takes in one.

Its review keeps no statement to write: one of a property value, or of a load before
reviews kept them.

Reviews at its place state different things, and no word of a person's says which. Of a
withdrawal: quotes a release before 4.16.0 wrote at its place, of several claims of its
link, keep no decision to tell them apart.
What its review states isn't what the decision's hash binds: not what the person read.

The document, cut into sections as the run cuts it, doesn't say the review's quote at its
place; the load keeps no record of the model work that stated it there; or the document's
set no longer states its link, or reads an end's type. Since 4.17.0 a release reads no
model work, so another prompt, model or artifact never refuses it.
An end resolves to no one entity: a resolve decision settles the name first.

Its link holds one value and an end is linked by legal form alone: a resolve decision
settles that name first.

An end is linked by part of one row's name alone, whatever its link holds: a resolve
decision settles that name first.

An end is linked by an identifier the verifier didn't accept, the name the text calls
it by, whatever its link holds: a resolve decision settles that name first.
Its hold isn't one a person's word releases.

It conflicts with what the load holds of its link: a property of the fact that differs
from the one set, or a second object of a one-valued link whose slot keeps no statements
to weigh, as a load before P3 wrote it. An approval of a one-valued link's claim
otherwise outranks what it conflicted with.

It would open a `block` violation, or checking that needed more reading than the budget
allows.

The load holds the document under its id with other text: the claim the person read may
not be in it any more. Only a new load reads the new text.

ReleasedDecision.description: What a run did with one release decision of a document, by the backend's id of the decision.

outcome.description: What the run did with it.

ResolvedCounts.description: How many of a document's entities each rung of the resolution ladder resolved.

adjudicated.description: Linked by independently verified adjudication, when explicitly enabled.

alias.description: By another of its names, its fullest naming none.

carried.description:
By its fullest name, a name a person linked to the entity once for the whole load
(an `alias` decision).

identifier.description: By an identifier the verifier accepted, that a row gave one stored entity.

legal_form.description: By its fullest name without its legal form: a review lets a person overturn it.

own_name.description:
By an identifier the verifier held back without refuting, that is the name the text
calls the entity by and one row holds: a review lets a person overturn it, and it is
held to what a link by part of a name is.

part_name.description:
By its fullest name being part of one row's name, the rest of which only says what kind
of thing the row is: a review lets a person overturn it.

user.description: Linked by a settled resolve decision.

Why.description: One reason a version needs a new load: its kind, and the item, as a dotted path.

item.description: Where, as a dotted path of its table.

WhyKind.description: What a version changes that needs a new load ([`Why`]).

oneOf.description: A link the base declares is gone.
A link both declare changed past its description.
A type was added.
A type both declare changed past its description and new properties, or a type is gone.
A type gained a property.
The description of a type or link a route reads changed: its calls change.
A route changed past gaining the links added.
A route may now resolve a type it didn't.
A relation was added, removed or changed.
An enrichment item was added, removed or changed.
A rule was added, removed or changed.
A constraint was added, removed or changed.
A mapping of rows was added, removed or changed.
The mappings' header changed: the ontology they name, or a key they lack.
A link added is required.
A link added derives others, or is derived.
A link added is stated by a mapping's rows or an enrichment's work history.
Anything else.
